items.html: And know that another time I heard it in a different way, in brief, and I do not know whether it is at the time of the Ibur [conception], or the nursing, or the Gadlut [greatness], for I heard it without specification. And it is this: that from the third of Tifferet the Keter of Galgalta of ZA was made, and from NHY three Mochin were made in it, and from the Yesod of Arich the rest of the body of ZA, in its entirety, expanded.
